user.title: Connect to the ECU
user.description: The ECU must be connected by Ethernet cable and Modbus must be enabled on the ECU (EMA Manager app via the ECU's access point: Local Access → Workspace → Modbus settings). Nothing else should poll the ECU over Modbus; it overloads easily.

data_description.host: IP address of the ECU on the wired network.
data_description.unit_ids: Leave empty to search automatically, or enter the addresses from EMA Manager, for example 1-8 or 1, 2, 5.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Inverters are recognised by serial number, so changing an address keeps their history.

data_description.host: IP address of the ECU on the wired network.
data_description.unit_ids: Leave empty to search automatically, or enter the addresses from EMA Manager, for example 1-8 or 1, 2, 5.

dhcp_confirm.title: APsystems ECU found
dhcp_confirm.description: Set up the APsystems ECU at {host}? Make sure Modbus is enabled on the ECU (EMA Manager, Local Access → Modbus settings) and that nothing else polls it over Modbus.

confirm.title: Inverters found: {count}
confirm.description:
{inverters}

Compare the addresses and serial numbers with the Modbus settings in EMA Manager.

data_description.ecu_id: The number on the ECU label, also shown in EMA Manager. Used for the device name; otherwise the first inverter identifies the ECU.
data_description.lifetime_energy: Total energy from the EMA app, in kWh. The lifetime counter continues from here. Leave empty to start at 0.

progress.scan: Searching for inverters. This takes up to a minute.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the ECU. Check the IP address and connect the ECU by Ethernet cable; Modbus TCP is not available over Wi-Fi.
error.modbus_disabled: The ECU refused the connection. Modbus is off by default: press the AP button on the ECU, connect to its Wi-Fi, open EMA Manager with Local Access and enable Modbus under Workspace → Modbus settings with an address for every inverter. Then try again.
error.not_apsystems: The device at this address is not an APsystems ECU.
error.no_inverters: No inverter answered. Give each inverter an address in the Modbus settings of EMA Manager (Local Access), or enter the addresses here.
error.ecu_busy: The ECU stopped answering during the search. Stop other Modbus clients, wait five minutes and try again.
error.unsupported_layout: The register layout differs from the tested ECU-R. Please share a register dump in an issue.
error.invalid_unit_ids: Enter addresses between 1 and 247, for example 1-8 or 1, 2, 5.
error.invalid_ecu_id: Enter the 12 digits of the ECU ID from the label, or leave it empty.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.different_ecu: The device at this address is a different ECU. Add it as a new integration instead.
abort.not_apsystems: The device at this address is not an APsystems ECU.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between polls. The ECU only refreshes its values about every 5 minutes, so lower values add load without new data.
data_description.lifetime_energy: Change only to correct the counter; it continues from the value you enter. The Energy dashboard shows the change once as production in that hour; adjust that hour under Developer tools → Statistics.
data_description.peak_power: Highest total power so far. Set to 0 to start over.

cannot_connect.message: No answer from the ECU at {host}. Check the IP address, connect the ECU by Ethernet cable and make sure Modbus is enabled on the ECU (EMA Manager, Local Access).

link_in_use.message: Another integration already uses the Modbus device at {host} with different connection settings.

unsupported_layout.message: The device does not serve the register layout of a supported APsystems ECU ({details}). Please share a register dump in an issue.

connection_lost.message: The connection to the ECU was lost. It is retried at the next poll.

no_inverter_answered.message: No inverter answered. The ECU may be busy; the next poll tries again.
